sermon.title: Making Right Choices - April 14, 2024
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: How can we make wise choices? Israel was delivered to worship, but accused, grumbled and believed the bad report, so they never saw the land. Joshua and Caleb, a tiny minority, had a different spirit and followed fully. That spirit is the sevenfold Spirit of Isaiah 11:2, which God now puts in us through the Holy Spirit.

faqs.question: Who calls God a liar?
faqs.answer: The media, the kingdom of darkness and other philosophies, when really they’re lying.

faqs.question: Is accepting Christ the end?
faqs.answer: No; there are steps you have to go through.

faqs.question: What did Israel say?
faqs.answer: I told you so; it would have been better to serve the Egyptians.

faqs.question: Is the wilderness Egypt?
faqs.answer: No; the promised land is where God wants to bring us.

faqs.question: What proof is there that God is real?
faqs.answer: He died, rose and is alive, and everyone here has experienced the Spirit.

faqs.question: Was it a spirit of tongues?
faqs.answer: No; behind the Spirit are these seven things.

faqs.question: Why does he treat his kids right?
faqs.answer: Because he has the fear of God and wants to train them up.

faqs.question: Where is God on your list?
faqs.answer: Are you taking time for Him this week?
